rows.subject: Claude

claim.text: Claude provides expert-level collaboration on the things you need to get done—from coding a product to critical data analysis.

evidence.text: After playing with this concept by having Claude Code reproduce redis and sqlite, I began looking for software packages where an agent-made reproduction might actually be useful.

rows.note: A user successfully using Claude Code to reproduce Redis and SQLite corroborates the claim that Claude can provide expert collaboration on coding a product.

rows.subject: Claude

claim.text: Performance: Top-tier results in reasoning, coding, multilingual tasks, long-context handling, honesty, and image processing.

evidence.text: We have seen the best results with Gemini models for visual reasoning, achieving SOTA (beating Claude Fable) on the strongest grounded reasoning benchmark we have found (Databricks OfficeQA).

rows.note: "Top-tier" means being among the best, not necessarily #1. Gemini achieving SOTA and beating Claude Fable does not contradict the top-tier claim, but provides specific qualifying context. Should be: updates.

rows.subject: Claude

claim.text: If you're unsure which model to use, start with Claude Opus 5 for most workloads.

evidence.text: We have identified the cause of elevated errors on requests to Claude Opus 5 and Claude Haiku 4.5 and are working on a fix.

rows.note: A recommendation to start with Opus 5 for most workloads does not speak to an incident report about elevated errors. Sharing the model name is not enough.
